events.name: San Diego Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Philip Rivers outplayed Peyton Manning, and the San Diego Chargers sprung a 27-20 upset Thursday night over the Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Chargers hand Broncos rare home loss
Cousins: 3 TDs, turnovers in losing debut

headlines.description: Jay Cutler shook off some early rustiness and threw three touchdown passes in his first start since Nov. 10, leading the Chicago Bears to a 38-31 win Sunday over the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutler's 3 TDs help Bears beat Browns

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes, and Robert Mathis broke the Colts' single-season and career sacks records by forcing a second-half safety to lead Indianapolis past reeling Houston 25-3 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck propels Colts with boost from Mathis

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Tom Brady's latest comeback bid came up short, and the Miami Dolphins helped their playoff chances with a 24-20 breakthrough victory Sunday over the AFC East-leading New England Patriots.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins foil Brady's comeback bid, top Pats

headlines.description: Cassel, Vikings stop Eagles 48-30 without Peterson
headlines.shortLinkText: Cassel, Vikings stop Eagles without Peterson

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New York Giants

headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks pick off Eli, manhandle Giants

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Kaepernick, 49ers rip Bucs 33-14, win 4th in a row
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick, 49ers rip Bucs, win 4th in a row

headlines.description: EJ Manuel threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score, leading the Buffalo Bills to a 27-20 victory against the banged-up Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manuel bounces back to lead Bills past Jags

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Jamaal Charles tied a franchise record with five touchdowns in a game, Alex Smith threw five TD passes and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Raiders 56-31 on Sunday to clinch at least a wild-card spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Charles has 5 TDs as Chiefs reach playoffs

events.name: New York Jets at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 273 yards and a touchdown, Captain Munnerlyn had two sacks and returned an interception for a score and the Carolina Panthers defeated the New York Jets 30-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers bounce back to beat Jets

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Matt Flynn threw four touchdown passes in the second half, Eddie Lacy had the winning score on a 1-yard plunge and the Green Bay Packers matched the biggest comeback in franchise history, rallying from 23 points down at halftime to beat the Dallas Cowboys
headlines.shortLinkText: Pack rally from 23 down, top Romo, Cowboys

headlines.description: Jay Feely kicked a 41-yard field goal in overtime, and the Arizona Cardinals edged the Tennessee Titans 37-34 in overtime after blowing a 17-point lead late in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals waste lead but beat Titans in OT

events.name: New Orleans Saints at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Rams delay Saints' postseason plans with 27-16 win
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints' playoff plans on hold after loss to Rams

headlines.description: Antonio Brown caught a touchdown pass and returned a punt for a score in a 64-second span in the first quarter and the Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Bengals 30-20 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers start strong to overwhelm Bengals
